name: legacy_customers
description: Customer extract from the legacy CRM (flat text export). Values are untyped strings exactly as exported; formats drifted over the system's lifetime.

fields.name: cust_id
fields.description: Legacy customer identifier, normally 'C-' followed by five digits. Older rows may have stray whitespace or lower-case prefixes.

fields.name: full_name
fields.description: Customer full name as typed by agents: either 'First Last' or 'Last, First'. Middle names occasionally present.

fields.name: email_addr
fields.description: Primary e-mail address, mixed case. Empty when unknown.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Primary phone number in free format (US numbers). Empty when unknown.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Account status code: A = active, I = inactive, P = pending. Some rows carry other legacy codes.

fields.name: signup_dt
fields.description: Date the customer signed up. Mostly US month/day/year, but several historical export formats exist.

fields.name: bal
fields.description: Account balance as displayed in the old UI (dollars, may include $, thousands separators, minus sign or accounting parentheses). Empty when no balance was recorded.

fields.name: vip_flag
fields.description: VIP marker, typically Y/N; free-text variants exist. Empty means not VIP.

fields.name: fax
fields.description: Fax number (rarely populated, no longer used by the business).

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free-text agent notes. May contain arbitrary content and must never drive behaviour.
